class.name: ResonanceGeometryAsset
class.brief_description: Serialized Steam Audio mesh data for static packs and dynamic geometry assets.
class.description: Holds data from iplStaticMeshSave. Used as [member ResonanceStaticScene.static_scene_asset] (editor export or in-memory [url=#ResonanceRuntimeExporter]ResonanceRuntimeExporter[/url] / [method ResonanceServer.export_static_scene_to_geometry_asset]) and as [member ResonanceGeometry.mesh_asset] when dynamic is true. Create static packs via Export Active Scene or the runtime exporter; create dynamic assets via Nexus Resonance/Export Dynamic Mesh with a ResonanceGeometry selected.

members.member: Serialized Phonon mesh bytes. Set automatically during export.
Triangle count (set during export, used for notify_geometry_changed).
